Printed edition: Travels into several remote nations of the world. In four parts. By Lemuel Gulliver, ... In this impression, several errors in the London edition are corrected.  1726: Vol 1-2, 1726, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_travels-into-several-rem_swift-jonathan_1726_1-2. The scan does not show the credit of Jonathan Swift, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
